pt.headline: Coxos oferece ondas consistentes e boa pontuação hoje
pt.advice: Aproveite a onda de 1,1 m com período de 9 s e vento moderado. Chegue cedo para pegar as melhores linhas e evite ficar na zona de quebra. A temperatura da água está agradável, mas ainda é recomendável usar roupa de neoprene.
pt.crowdTip: Chegue antes das 9h para evitar a maioria dos surfistas.

en.headline: Coxos delivers consistent waves and top score today
en.advice: Take advantage of the 1.1 m wave with a 9‑second period and moderate wind. Arrive early to catch the best sections and stay out of the breaking zone. Water temperature is comfortable, but a wetsuit is still advised.
en.crowdTip: Get there before 9 am to beat most surfers.

spots.name: Supertubos
spots.ptReason: Ondas boas e vento aceitável; vale a pena ir cedo para evitar multidão.
spots.enReason: Good waves and acceptable wind; worth going early to beat the crowd.

spots.name: Guincho
spots.ptReason: Ondas consistentes, mas vento um pouco mais forte; ainda surfável.
spots.enReason: Consistent waves but slightly stronger wind; still surfable.

spots.name: Nazaré
spots.ptReason: Ondas de 1 m são manejáveis e vento leve; ideal para prática.
spots.enReason: 1 m waves are manageable and wind is light; ideal for practice.

spots.name: Coxos
spots.ptReason: Melhor pontuação do dia, ondas consistentes e vento moderado; spot recomendado.
spots.enReason: Highest score today, consistent waves and moderate wind; recommended spot.

spots.name: Arrifana
spots.ptReason: Vento muito leve (2 nós) e boas ondas; ótimo para quem busca conforto.
spots.enReason: Very light wind (2 knots) and good waves; great for a comfortable session.

spots.enReason: Low score indicates weak waves and likely heavy crowd; better to pick another spot.
